Market today: Geopolitical tensions (Iran war) are driving oil prices up, shifting focus away from growth/tech. This creates headwinds for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.92%) and SPAL (-57.93%) are bleeding heavily, amplified by margin and their leveraged nature. SMH (-15.32%) and QQQ (-4.35%) also show "SELL" status and are below their stops or close to it.

Watch: Keep a close eye on geopolitical developments and how they impact oil prices. Also, watch for any follow-through from South Korean chip rally or further "Magnificent Seven" rotation.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech/chip exposure is under pressure; managing risk is paramount right now.
plays: Trim SOXL: Your -54.92% loss on SOXL is massive. Consider trimming to reduce leveraged exposure, especially with its decay.
Respect QQQ stop: QQQ is at -4.35% and its stop is 670. Be ready to exit if it breaks that level to protect capital.
No new buys today - hold and watch: The market mood is uncertain for your sector, and existing positions need attention.
